name: Pet Ecology Brands, Inc.
summary: Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Pet Ecology Brands, Inc. was a U.S. company involved in the conception, production, and commercialization of pet-related goods. Its primary offerings included innovative lightweight, flushable, and odor-neutral cat litters, complemented by a range of fat-free dog treats. The company is currently undergoing liquidation proceedings.
